scripts.build: pnpm --filter @scace/db build && pnpm --filter @scace/api build && pnpm --filter @scace/docs build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @scace/db build && pnpm --filter @scace/db lint && pnpm --filter @scace/api lint && pnpm --filter @scace/docs lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @scace/db build && pnpm --filter @scace/db typecheck && pnpm --filter @scace/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @scace/docs typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @scace/db build && pnpm --filter @scace/db test && pnpm --filter @scace/api test
scripts.clean: pnpm --filter @scace/db clean && pnpm --filter @scace/api clean && pnpm --filter @scace/docs clean && rm -rf dist .turbo
